checks.label: The scalar product of two vectors is obtained by multiplying their magnitudes with the cosine of the angle between them: wherever either tip is dragged, the dot product drawn is the two sizes times the cosine of the angle between the drawn arrows, its readout says so, and adding up the parts gives the same number

The dot product is a scalar while the cross product is a vector: every dot product worked out on screen is a plain number with no i, j or k, and the answer written as an arrow is marked wrong and drawn in red

The scalar product of orthogonal vectors vanishes and the scalar product of antiparallel vectors is negative: arrows square to each other cast only a dot of shadow and give nothing, and arrows pointing opposite ways give a negative number

The work that a force performs while causing a displacement is the scalar product of the force vector with the displacement vector: at every angle the rope can be swung to, the work drawn is the pull dotted with the move, and so it is for the other ropes

Every number follows from the rule: shadow 3 and 3 × 4 = 12; 3 × 6 = 18; 20 at 0°, 0 at 90°, −20 at 180°; 5 × 4 × cos 120° = −10; 12 + 12 = 24 at 16.26°; 2 − 2 = 0; 2 + 6 + 12 = 20 and 20 ÷ 21 gives 17.75°; cos⁻¹(4 ÷ 9) = 63.61°; 200 × 5 × cos 30° = 866.03 J with a 173.21 N shadow; 150 × 4 = 600 J; 230 × 23 × 0.8 = 4232 W; −40 × 3 = −120 J; and every wrong answer offered is a slip worked from the same values

As a swings from lying along b to pointing back the other way, its shadow on b's line shrinks at every step, is only a dot when the two are square, and falls behind the start only once they lean apart
Every puzzle offers three different answers with exactly one accepted, gives each wrong one its own hint, and draws a wrong pick in red but a right one without
Before Check no puzzle's picture shows its answer, and a right answer shows it
Every demonstration has finished arriving within 5 s of its screen opening, none starting before the 0.35 s screen fade ends; every answer's motion within 2.5 s
